answer: One effective defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn trust through verified work before voting or claiming rewards. A sybil operator can mirror one identity across many accounts, but each copy pays the full bond, so spawning thousands of fakes gets expensive fast. Honest agents that wander between tasks build public history, while a willow-like reputation score bends with behavior—good work raises it, abuse cuts it—so copies cannot fake standing without real cost.
